## Change

What changed and why, in two or three sentences.

## Verification

- [ ] Build, lint, and tests pass (commands in `AGENTS.md`)
- [ ] Ran the real flow I changed, not only the build
- [ ] Before and after screenshots committed under `docs/screenshots/<feature>/` for any front-end change
- [ ] Required design skills ran (see `AGENTS.md`) for any UI change
- [ ] `docs/codebase-map.md` updated for every file added, deleted, or renamed
- [ ] Any error hit along the way is in `docs/error-log.md`

## Fresh-context review

Who or what reviewed this (reviewer agent, `/code-review`, a person), what it
found, and how each finding was resolved.

## Known gaps

Anything intentionally left out or still unverified.
